name: browser-relay
description: Let agents use the Chrome you already have open and logged in through a Skill + CLI, locally or across machines.

interface.shortDescription: Share your logged-in Chrome with an agent
interface.longDescription: Use Browser Relay through a Skill and CLI to let an agent work in the Chrome you already have open and logged in, without launching a blank automation browser. Use it locally or reach an explicitly enabled browser on another machine.
defaultPrompt: Use Browser Relay to tell me the title of my current Chrome tab.
Use Browser Relay on a background tab without switching my foreground tab.
Use Browser Relay to list the browsers available on my other machines.
